GRAMMAR 2, ORQA MUQOVA (PDF 86, oxirgi skan). To'q sariq fon. O'rtada och ko'k ramkali quti: 'ENTERPRISE' (to'q sariq, quyosh belgisi), 'GRAMMAR 2' (ko'k). Matn: 'Enterprise Grammar 2 gives students at Elementary level clear explanations and practice of English grammar.' 'Key features:' • clear simple explanations and examples • a variety of stimulating exercises • lively illustrations • revision sections within each unit • progress tests. 'Components': Enterprise Grammar 2 Student's Book; Enterprise Grammar 2 Teacher's Book. Pastda Express Publishing logotipi (kitob-qush belgisi). Shtrix-kod: ISBN-13: 978-1-903128-75-6, ISBN-10: 1-903128-75-7, 9781903128756 (ustiga oq yorliq yopishtirilgan). Bet raqami yo'q.

⚠ Progress Test 8 95-betda tugaydi; 96-bet (uning orqasi) skanda yo'q - bo'sh bo'lsa kerak.
